title: Moving sub-cell (partially saturated) wall + per-step hook: analytic verification
why: R3 closed the stationary sub-cell wall but explicitly left two holes: (a) the moving sub-cell wall (the Noble-Torczynski momentum term 6 w_i (c_i.u_w), reachable through partial_cell_layer(velocity=...)) was never measured -- only a smoke test asserted 'moving differs from stationary'; (b) per-step setup hooks were never exercised together with a sub-cell mask, which is the anchor's own subject. R4 measures both against a closed-form Couette solution and fixes the solid-limit defect R3 pinned as xfail.

geometry.cell_centres: integer y; cell k spans [k-0.5, k+0.5]
geometry.rows: row 0 fully solid (bounce); row 1 partially saturated, solid on its low face; row ny-1 the second wall
geometry.case: plane Couette with the *bottom* wall moving at U and the top wall stationary

parameters.stop_rule: 12 transient e-folding times of the Couette start-up + 200 steps (run_xval.steps_for_couette), unchanged from R1/R2/R3

arms.naive_eps: BoundaryLayer(kind='moving', mask=eps_s): raw solid fraction as blend weight, pre-collision reflection (upstream transplant + momentum)
arms.nt_pre: partial_cell_layer(reflect='pre'): NT weight B, pre-collision reflection, momentum term scaled by B
arms.nt_post: partial_cell_layer(reflect='post'): NT weight B, post-collision reflection, momentum term scaled by B (library default)
arms.staircase: moving_bounce_layer on row 1 with mask=1 (eps_s=1 reference, no sub-cell position)

metrics.u_wall_recovered: linear least-squares fit u = a + b y over fluid rows, evaluated at y_b, divided by U (1.0 = wall velocity reproduced)
metrics.offset_err_dx: y at which the fitted line reaches U, minus y_b (dx)
metrics.note: the partially saturated row itself is a fluid/solid mixture and is excluded from every error norm (same convention as R3)

predictions.P1_hook_drives_sub_cell_wall: a per-step setup_step hook writing the wall velocity into state and a callable velocity on the partial layer reproduces the direct-argument run bit-wise; a hook writing zero leaves the field at rest
predictions.P2_hook_ramp_equivalence: ramping the hook-driven wall velocity 0 -> U over 200 steps and then running to the same stop rule reproduces the constant-U profile within 1 % L2
predictions.P3_solid_limit_moving_bitwise: eps_s = 1 with the library default collapses bit-wise to moving_bounce_layer (this is the R3 xfail; it holds only after the solid-limit fix)
predictions.P4_wall_velocity_recovered: the fitted velocity at y_b equals U within 3 % for the library default at every eps_s
predictions.P5_profile_accuracy: profile L2 < 3 % for the library default at every eps_s and both ny
predictions.P6_error_monotone_in_eps: the profile L2 decreases monotonically with eps_s (no interior minimum) for every arm

stop_rule_if: any arm is non-finite, or the hook fails to reach the boundary condition (P1 false) -- then report the operator defect instead of tuning arms
